name: Type Zoom
description: One big word fills the frame, then the camera dives into it until the letters' color swallows the screen, and the color clears to reveal the next shot.
useWhen: A bold, type-led cut between scenes or into a section: "NEXT", "WAIT", a product or chapter name, a hype word in a launch video. Put it on a track above both clips and center it on the cut (from = cut frame − half its length): the screen is fully covered at its midpoint. Short words (1–6 letters) zoom best.

color.label: Text color
color.help: Also the color that fills the screen at the cut.

backdrop.label: Start on background
backdrop.help: Off: the word dives in over the outgoing shot.

originX.label: Zoom point X
originX.help: Aim it at a letter's stroke to dive into the letter.
